sections.title: OH VALLEY
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH OVER THE CNTRL PLAINS TODAY WILL MOVE ENEWD INTO THE MID TO UPPER MS VALLEY. AN MCS ASSOCIATED WITH THE LOW-LEVEL JET SHOULD BE ONGOING ACROSS ERN MO AND IL THIS MORNING. AHEAD OF AND TO THE SOUTH OF THE MCS...A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS SHOULD BE IN PLACE FROM THE MID-MS VALLEY ENEWD ACROSS IND AND OH. THE NAM AND GFS SOLUTIONS INCREASE MLCAPE VALUES INTO THE 2000 TO 3000 J/KG RANGE BY EARLY AFTERNOON. THE CURRENT THINKING IS THAT THUNDERSTORMS WILL INITIATE ON THE SRN SIDE OF THE DECAYING MCS ALONG THE WRN EDGE OF STRONG INSTABILITY WITH A SECOND MCS ORGANIZING AND MOVING ENEWD ACROSS THE OH VALLEY. HAVE TAKEN A COMPROMISE BETWEEN THE GFS AND NAM SOLUTIONS WHICH WOULD TAKE THE CONVECTION ACROSS CNTRL IL...CNTRL IND AND WRN OH LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY THIS EVENING. ETA-KF FORECAST SOUNDINGS FROM CNTRL IL AND CNTRL IND LATE THIS AFTERNOON SHOW 30 TO 40 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR WITH UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES AND STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. THIS ENVIRONMENT SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR A BOWING LINE-SEGMENT WITH AN ENHANCED WIND DAMAGE THREAT. THE GFS AND NAM SOLUTIONS BOTH APPEAR TO DEVELOP A LINEAR MCS WHICH SUPPORTS THIS IDEA. sections.title: SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: HEIGHTS WILL RISE ACROSS THE GREAT PLAINS TODAY AS AN UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE BUILDS NWD INTO THE CNTRL AND NRN PLAINS. SLY FLOW WILL REMAIN ENHANCED ON THE WRN SIDE OF THE RIDGE IN THE SRN HIGH PLAINS ALLOWING A MOIST AIRMASS TO REMAIN IN PLACE ACROSS WEST TX...THE OK PANHANDLE AND SW KS. THIS SHOULD RESULT IN MODERATE DESTABILIZATION ACROSS THE REGION WITH THUNDERSTORMS INITIATING ACROSS THE SLIGHT RISK AREA IN THE LATE AFTERNOON. DUE TO THE LACK OF LARGE-SCALE ASCENT...ANY THUNDERSTORMS THAT INITIATE SHOULD REMAIN RATHER ISOLATED LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EARLY THIS EVENING. ETA-KF FORECAST SOUNDINGS ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE AT 00Z SHOW 35 TO 40 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR WITH SUBSTANTIAL DIRECTIONAL SHEAR BELOW 700 MB. THIS SHEAR ENVIRONMENT ALONG WITH MODERATE INSTABILITY SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT WITH LARGE HAIL THE PRIMARY THREAT. A POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS COULD ALSO DEVELOP ESPECIALLY IF A CLUSTER OF STORMS CAN ORGANIZE ACROSS THE REGION EARLY THIS EVENING.

sections.title: ERN SEABOARD
sections.text: A VERY MOIST AIRMASS WILL REMAIN IN PLACE ACROSS THE CAROLINAS AND GA TODAY WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS SHOULD BE IN THE LOWER 70S F. THIS SHOULD AGAIN RESULT IN MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY BY EARLY AFTERNOON WITH SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING FROM THE SRN APPALACHIAN MTNS IN NC SWD ACROSS THE COASTAL PLAINS OF ERN GA. ETA-KF FORECAST SOUNDINGS ACROSS SC AND ERN GA AT 21Z SHOW MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 2000 TO 3000 J/KG WITH WEAK DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND VERY STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. THIS ENVIRONMENT COULD BE FAVORABLE FOR PULSE STORMS WITH STRONG WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: NRN ROCKIES
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL LOW WILL MOVE SLOWLY SSEWD ACROSS THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST TODAY AS SOUTHWEST FLOW REMAINS IN PLACE ACROSS THE NRN ROCKIES. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD INITIATE EAST OF THE UPPER-LEVEL LOW IN THE NRN ROCKIES AS SFC TEMPS WARM TODAY. THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR STRONG UPDRAFTS SHOULD EXIST ACROSS ERN ID AND SRN MT NEAR THE EXIT REGION OF THE MID-LEVEL JET. ETA-KF FORECAST SOUNDINGS IN ERN ID AND SRN MT DEVELOP MLCAPE OF 1000-1200 J/KG WITH 0-6KM SHEAR IN THE 45 TO 55 KT RANGE. THIS COMBINED WITH VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR A SUPERCELL THREAT WITH A POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL. AN ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUST POTENTIAL SHOULD ALSO EXIST ESPECIALLY DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON WHEN LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD BE STEEPEST. ..BROYLES/GARNER.. 06/15/2010

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MIDLEVEL TROUGH EXTENDING FROM THE DAKOTAS INTO KS THIS MORNING WILL DE-AMPLIFY THROUGH THE PERIOD WHILE ACCELERATING NEWD THROUGH THE GREAT LAKES REGION IN ADVANCE OF INTENSIFYING UPPER TROUGH OVER THE WRN STATES. IN THE LOW LEVELS...WEAK SURFACE LOW NOW ANALYZED OVER CNTRL IA WILL DEVELOP SLOWLY EWD INTO NRN IL TODAY PRIOR TO ACCELERATING ENEWD ACROSS NRN PARTS OF IND/OH AND SRN LOWER MI TONIGHT ALONG ASSOCIATED BAROCLINIC ZONE. THE NRN EXTENSION OF TRAILING COLD FRONT WILL PUSH EWD/SEWD THROUGH THE MID MS VALLEY AND OZARKS WHILE WRN EXTENSION BEGINS TO LIFT NWD THROUGH THE SRN HIGH PLAINS. MEANWHILE...PACIFIC FRONT FROM THE NRN INTER-MOUNTAIN REGION INTO THE GREAT BASIN WILL SLOWLY SHIFT EWD/SEWD TODAY AND TONIGHT.

sections.title: MID MS VALLEY ACROSS THE OH VALLEY
sections.text: CURRENT SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AND SATELLITE-DERIVED PW DATA INDICATE A MOIST AIR MASS IN PLACE ACROSS THE REGION WITH DEW POINTS IN THE 60S TO AROUND 70 F AND PW VALUES OF 1.50-1.75 INCHES. WHILE MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE NOT EXPECTED TO BE PARTICULARLY STEEP...THIS MOISTURE COUPLED WITH DAYTIME HEATING WILL CONTRIBUTE TO A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AFTERNOON ENVIRONMENT WITH MLCAPE APPROACHING 1500-2500 J/KG. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT TSTMS WILL INTENSIFY LATER THIS MORNING INTO THIS AFTERNOON ALONG LEADING EDGE OF DECAYING MCS CURRENTLY LIFTING NEWD THROUGH THE OZARK PLATEAU. AREA VWPS AND 12Z SGF SOUNDING DATA CONFIRM A BELT OF 40-45 KT FLOW IN THE 3-6 KM AGL LAYER ATTENDING THE MESOSCALE SYSTEM WHICH SHOULD DEVELOP NEWD THROUGH THE MID MS VALLEY LATER TODAY. THIS STRENGTHENING WIND FIELD IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS WHICH SHOULD EVENTUALLY GROW UPSCALE INTO A FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS. HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE MAIN HAZARDS...THOUGH A TORNADO OR TWO ARE POSSIBLE WITH ANY STRONGER MESOVORTICES OR EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS. AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS SHOULD PERSIST INTO

sections.title: NRN GREAT BASIN INTO MT
sections.text: LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATES THAT THE MOST SIGNIFICANT HEIGHT FALLS/DYNAMIC FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH AMPLIFYING MIDLEVEL TROUGH WILL OCCUR WITHIN POST FRONTAL AIR MASS OF WRN WA/ORE EVENTUALLY INTO THE SIERRA NEVADA RANGE. NONETHELESS... REGION WILL RESIDE WITHIN THE ERN FRINGE OF STRONGER FORCING WHERE STEEP LAPSE RATES AND PW VALUES OF 0.50-0.75 INCH WILL YIELD POCKETS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE OF 500-1000 J/KG. MESOSCALE AND HIGH-RESOLUTION MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGEST THAT TSTMS SHOULD INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING ALONG AND AHEAD OF SURFACE FRONT. THE STEEP LAPSE RATES COUPLED WITH DEEP SWLY SHEAR STRENGTHENING TO 45-55 KT WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF A FEW ORGANIZED/ROTATING STORMS CAPABLE OF MAINLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL THROUGH THIS EVENING.

sections.title: SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: MIDLEVEL HEIGHTS WILL REBOUND TODAY IN THE WAKE OF SHORT WAVE TROUGH LIFTING NEWD AWAY FROM THE REGION. AS SUCH...DIURNAL STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL BE LARGELY MODULATED BY THE PRE-EXISTING SYNOPTIC FRONT AND ANY RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES LINGERING FROM ONGOING TSTM ACTIVITY. BOUNDARY LAYER SHOULD REMAIN MOIST TODAY WITH DEW POINTS IN THE 60S BENEATH STEADILY STRENGTHENING EML SPREADING EWD FROM THE SRN ROCKIES. RESULTANT AIR MASS IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MODERATE TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON WITH MLCAPE OF 2000-3000 J/KG. WHILE MIDLEVEL HEIGHT GRADIENT WILL TEND TO RELAX WITH PASSAGE OF MIDLEVEL IMPULSE...LOCALLY BACKED SURFACE WINDS INVOF OF ABOVE-MENTIONED BOUNDARIES WILL RESULT IN 30-35 KT OF DEEP WLY SHEAR...SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF MAINLY HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: E-CNTRL/SERN MN INTO WRN/SRN WI
sections.text: A CORRIDOR OF WEAK AIR MASS DESTABILIZATION IS FORECAST TODAY ALONG INVERTED TROUGH/OCCLUDED FRONT IN WAKE OF NOCTURNAL TSTMS CURRENTLY MOVING ACROSS WI. WHILE LAPSE RATES WILL NOT BE PARTICULARLY STEEP...INCREASED FORCING FOR ASCENT AHEAD OF MIDLEVEL TROUGH AND STRENGTHENING VERTICAL SHEAR MAY FOSTER A FEW STRONG STORMS CAPABLE OF STRONG WIND GUSTS AND SOME HAIL THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING.

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC AND SERN STATES WWD INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS INDICATE THE PRESENCE OF A VERY MOIST AND POTENTIALLY STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS OVER A WIDESPREAD AREA. LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL REMAIN WEAK WITH DIURNAL STORM DEVELOPMENT BEING FOCUSED ALONG FAVORED TERRAIN AND PRE-EXISTING BOUNDARIES. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL ALSO REMAIN QUITE WEAK...HOWEVER THE STRONGER PULSE STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL. ..MEAD/SMITH.. 06/15/2010

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PARTS OF WEST TX
sections.text: ...OH VALLEY/CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS... A WELL-DEVELOPED BOWING LINE-SEGMENT IS ONGOING ACROSS THE OH VALLEY LOCATED ALONG THE WRN EDGE OF STRONG INSTABILITY. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SUGGESTS THE STRONG INSTABILITY EXTENDS FROM NEAR THE OH RIVER IN WRN KY EWD INTO WV SUGGESTING THE LINEAR MCS SHOULD CONTINUE TO REMAIN STRONG THROUGH PART OF THE EVENING. THE BOWING LINE-SEGMENT IS ALSO BEING SUPPORTED BY A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE MID TO UPPER MS VALLEY. A REAR INFLOW JET IS EVIDENT JUST BEHIND THE BOWING LINE IN THE BASE OF THE TROUGH. THIS FEATURE WILL ALSO HELP SUSTAIN THE LINE EWD INTO THE CNTRL APPALACHIAN MTNS THIS EVENING. A VERY MOIST AND UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER COMBINED WITH AN MCS FORWARD MOTION OF 55 KT WILL BE VERY FAVORABLE FOR WIND DAMAGE OVER THE NEXT 1 TO 2 HOURS. VERY STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE NEAR THE APEX OF THE BOW IN SW OH AND NRN KY. SUPERCELLS WILL BE POSSIBLE AHEAD OF THE LINE NEAR THE OH RIVER WITH LARGE HAIL AND AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT WITH THESE CELLS.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING IN SERN MT ALONG AND TO THE EAST OF A COLD FRONT LOCATED FROM WEST OF GLASGOW SSWWD TO WEST OF BILLINGS. EAST OF THE FRONT IN SE MT...SFC OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS FIELDS SHOW MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 750 TO 1250 J/KG RANGE...0-6 MK SHEAR AROUND 50 KT AND 700 TO 500 MB LAPSE RATES IN GREATER THAN 7.5 C/KM. THIS ENVIRONMENT SHOULD SUPPORT A THREAT FOR SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL WITH THE GREATEST THREAT SOUTH OF I-94 TO THE WYOMING STATE-LINE. IN ADDITION...A NARROW AXIS OF VERY STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES EXISTS FROM THE CLUSTER OF STORMS EWD ABOUT 80 STATUTE MILES SUGGESTING A WIND DAMAGE THREAT WILL ALSO EXIST WITH THE MORE INTENSE CELLS.

sections.title: WEST TX
sections.text: SEVERAL STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING ACROSS WEST TX ALONG THE WRN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY NEAR AND JUST TO THE EAST OF A DRYLINE. SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 60S F ALONG WITH TEMPS IN THE UPPER 80S F ARE RESULTING IN MLCAPE VALUES IN THE 1500 TO 3000 J/KG RANGE ESTIMATED BY OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS. THIS COMBINED WITH 35 TO 45 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT AN ISOLATED SUPERCELL AND LARGE HAIL THREAT FOR A FEW MORE HOURS. ..BROYLES.. 06/16/2010
